_note: Every value here MUST match the production constant byte-for-byte. Drift breaks claude-code wire parity. Citations: FileReadTool/utils.ts:158 (size cap error), FileEditTool/utils.ts:405 (patch truncation suffix). 1-based line indexing per claude-code semantics. Tool names match the claude-code tool registry exactly.

read_size_limit.note: 256 KB. Locked at MAX_FILE_READ_SIZE. Error message is now byte-VERBATIM to claude-code FileTooLargeError (readFileInRange.ts:62-64), formatting both sizes via formatFileSize.
read_size_limit.error_template: File content ({size}) exceeds maximum allowed size ({max}). Use offset and limit parameters to read specific portions of the file, or search for specific content instead of reading the whole file.

binary_detection.note: Primary detection is by extension (BINARY_EXTENSIONS, constants/files.ts) before any read; the 8 KB NUL scan is the fallback for extensionless/non-listed binaries. Message is byte-VERBATIM to FileReadTool.ts:479 with the lowercased extension interpolated.
binary_detection.error_template: This tool cannot read binary files. The file appears to be a binary {ext} file. Please use appropriate tools for binary file analysis.

path_blocked_error.template: File path {path} is outside trusted directories
path_blocked_error.note: PII-tagged path routes to proto-tagged BigQuery column.

path_blocked_event_name.note: Cross-cutting event (not in tengu/tool.rs registry); declared inline in shared/path_validation.rs.

patch_truncation_suffix.note: `{N}` is the literal placeholder substituted with the elided-line count.

grep_records_cap.note: GREP_RECORDS_CAP. Memory valve on RECORDED content-mode lines per file; never caps the count (claude-code/rg have no per-file cap). head_limit (default 250) is the real truncation; count mode reports the true total.

line_indexing_base.note: 1-based for tool input/output (claude-code convention). LSP wire is 0-based — converted in M2-03.
